workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 傳導冷卻設計練習：把同一個 8 T、L = 20 H、I = 100 A 的 NbTi 線圈改由 RDK-415D2 等級冷頭（1.5 W @ 4.2 K、35 W @ 50 K）傳導冷卻。二級靜態負載：輻射 21 mW + G-10 支撐 16 mW + HTS 引線 2×25 mW + 儀表導線 10 mW = 97 mW；升流時再加開關加熱器 30 mW 與交流損耗 0.2 W，共 0.33 W。假設冷頭負載線為 T = 2.8 K + 0.93 K/W×P、冷頭到線圈的熱鏈為 1 W/K，靜態線圈溫度 2.8 + 0.09 + 0.10 ≈ 2.99 K，升流時 2.8 + 0.31 + 0.33 ≈ 3.43 K，距 T_cs = 4.66 K 尚有 1.23 K。若 50→4.2 K 段仍用銅引線，二級負載 1.56 + 0.10 = 1.66 W，冷頭升到約 4.35 K、線圈約 6.0 K，已高於 T_cs，磁體無法到場。一級：銅引線 9.3 W + 屏蔽 3 W + 支撐與導線約 1 W ≈ 13.3 W，低於 35 W。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Conduction-cooling exercise: the same 8 T NbTi coil with L = 20 H and I = 100 A is cooled by a cold head of the RDK-415D2 class (1.5 W at 4.2 K, 35 W at 50 K). Second-stage static load: radiation 21 mW + G-10 supports 16 mW + HTS leads 2×25 mW + instrumentation wiring 10 mW = 97 mW; during a ramp the switch heater adds 30 mW and AC loss 0.2 W, for 0.33 W. Assuming a cold-head load line T = 2.8 K + 0.93 K/W×P and a 1 W/K thermal link to the coil, the static coil temperature is 2.8 + 0.09 + 0.10 ≈ 2.99 K and the ramping value 2.8 + 0.31 + 0.33 ≈ 3.43 K, still 1.23 K below T_cs = 4.66 K. Keeping copper leads from 50 to 4.2 K raises the second-stage load to 1.56 + 0.10 = 1.66 W, the head to about 4.35 K and the coil to about 6.0 K, above T_cs, so the magnet cannot reach field. First stage: copper leads 9.3 W + shield 3 W + supports and wiring about 1 W ≈ 13.3 W, below 35 W. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「臨界面、負載線與溫度裕度」與「4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 臨界面、負載線與溫度裕度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Critical surface, load line and temperature margin: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「NbTi 導體工作點」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “NbTi conductor operating point” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超導線圈只有在溫度、磁場與電流密度三者同時低於臨界面時才是零電阻。NbTi 的 Tc₀ 約 9.2 K、Bc₂₀ 約 14.5 T，延展性好、可直接繞線，是 MRI 與多數研究磁體的主力；Nb₃Sn 的 Tc 約 18 K、4.2 K 時上臨界場約 25 T 等級，但脆且對應變敏感，必須先繞線再於約 650 °C 反應熱處理。線圈的工作點沿負載線移動：電流增加時峰值磁場同比例上升，因此真正的設計餘量是電流分流溫度 T_cs 與操作溫度之差，而不是 Tc 與 4.2 K 之差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NbTi 導體工作點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A superconducting coil is resistanceless only while temperature, field and current density all sit below the critical surface. NbTi, with Tc0 about 9.2 K and Bc20 about 14.5 T, is ductile enough to wind directly and is the workhorse of MRI and most research magnets; Nb3Sn, with Tc about 18 K and an upper critical field of order 25 T at 4.2 K, is brittle and strain-sensitive, so it is wound first and reacted near 650 °C. The coil operating point moves along a load line on which peak field rises in proportion to current, so the real design margin is the gap between the current-sharing temperature T_cs and the operating temperature, not between Tc and 4.2 K. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NbTi conductor operating point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以經驗式 Bc₂(T) ≈ Bc₂₀[1 − (T/Tc₀)^1.7] 估算：4.2 K 時 Bc₂ ≈ 10.7 T，2.2 K 時 ≈ 13.2 T，這是 NbTi 磁體超過約 9 T 就要降到 2.2 K 的原因。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the empirical Bc2(T) ≈ Bc20[1 − (T/Tc0)^1.7] gives Bc2 ≈ 10.7 T at 4.2 K and ≈ 13.2 T at 2.2 K, which is why NbTi magnets above roughly 9 T are pumped to 2.2 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「NbTi 的 Tc 是 9.2 K，所以在 4.2 K 運轉有約 5 K 的安全裕度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Since NbTi has Tc = 9.2 K, operating at 4.2 K leaves about 5 K of safety margin." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「NbTi 導體工作點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “NbTi conductor operating point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 臨界面、負載線與溫度裕度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical surface, load line and temperature margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「NbTi 導體工作點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “NbTi conductor operating point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以經驗式 Bc₂(T) ≈ Bc₂₀[1 − (T/Tc₀)^1.7] 估算：4.2 K 時 Bc₂ ≈ 10.7 T，2.2 K 時 ≈ 13.2 T，這是 NbTi 磁體超過約 9 T 就要降到 2.2 K 的原因。峰值場 8 T 時 Tc(B) = 9.2×(1 − 8/14.5)^(1/1.7) ≈ 5.74 K；若運轉電流為 4.2 K 臨界電流的 70%，以線性 Jc(T) 近似 T_cs ≈ 5.74 − 0.7×(5.74 − 4.2) ≈ 4.66 K，在 4.2 K 液氦浴中只剩約 0.46 K 裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the empirical Bc2(T) ≈ Bc20[1 − (T/Tc0)^1.7] gives Bc2 ≈ 10.7 T at 4.2 K and ≈ 13.2 T at 2.2 K, which is why NbTi magnets above roughly 9 T are pumped to 2.2 K. At a peak field of 8 T, Tc(B) = 9.2×(1 − 8/14.5)^(1/1.7) ≈ 5.74 K; running at 70% of the 4.2 K critical current, a linear Jc(T) approximation gives T_cs ≈ 5.74 − 0.7×(5.74 − 4.2) ≈ 4.66 K, leaving only about 0.46 K of margin in a 4.2 K bath. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取同批導線的短樣，在變溫插件中於 4.2 K 量 Ic(B)（以 0.1 µV/cm 為判準），在 6、8、10 T 各取一點並擬合臨界面參數；再把線圈負載線疊上去，讀出各電流下的峰值場與 T_cs，與設計表比較，並確認導線供應商的 Ic 證書與自行量測差異在數個百分比內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Ic(B) on short samples from the same conductor batch at 4.2 K with a 0.1 µV/cm criterion in a variable-temperature insert, take points at 6, 8 and 10 T and fit the critical-surface parameters; then overlay the coil load line to read the peak field and T_cs at each current, compare with the design table, and confirm that the supplier's Ic certificate agrees with your own data within a few percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 臨界面、負載線與溫度裕度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Critical surface, load line and temperature margin: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「NbTi 導體工作點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “NbTi conductor operating point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 取同批導線的短樣，在變溫插件中於 4.2 K 量 Ic(B)（以 0.1 µV/cm 為判準），在 6、8、10 T 各取一點並擬合臨界面參數；再把線圈負載線疊上去，讀出各電流下的峰值場與 T_cs，與設計表比較，並確認導線供應商的 Ic 證書與自行量測差異在數個百分比內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Ic(B) on short samples from the same conductor batch at 4.2 K with a 0.1 µV/cm criterion in a variable-temperature insert, take points at 6, 8 and 10 T and fit the critical-surface parameters; then overlay the coil load line to read the peak field and T_cs at each current, compare with the design table, and confirm that the supplier's Ic certificate agrees with your own data within a few percent. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只用中心場而非線圈內緣的峰值場計算裕度，實際工作點會比設計更靠近臨界面；運轉時一點點熱擾動或冷頭溫度上升數百 mK 就觸發失超，而且失超總在接近滿場時發生。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Computing margin from the central field instead of the peak field at the winding's inner edge places the true operating point closer to the critical surface than designed; a small disturbance or a few hundred millikelvin of cold-head warming then triggers quenches that consistently occur near full field.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取同批導線的短樣，在變溫插件中於 4.2 K 量 Ic(B)（以 0.1 µV/cm 為判準），在 6、8、10 T 各取一點並擬合臨界面參數；再把線圈負載線疊上去，讀出各電流下的峰值場與 T_cs，與設計表比較，並確認導線供應商的 Ic 證書與自行量測差異在數個百分比內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Ic(B) on short samples from the same conductor batch at 4.2 K with a 0.1 µV/cm criterion in a variable-temperature insert, take points at 6, 8 and 10 T and fit the critical-surface parameters; then overlay the coil load line to read the peak field and T_cs at each current, compare with the design table, and confirm that the supplier's Ic certificate agrees with your own data within a few percent.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨界面、負載線與溫度裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Critical surface, load line and temperature margin"?
options: 取同批導線的短樣，在變溫插件中於 4.2 K 量 Ic(B)（以 0.1 µV/cm 為判準），在 6、8、10 T 各取一點並擬合臨界面參數。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
持續電流模式下電流永遠不會衰減。
optionsEn: Measure Ic(B) on short samples from the same conductor batch at 4.2 K with a 0.1 µV/cm criterion in a variable-temperature insert, take points at 6, 8 and 10 T and fit the critical-surface parameters.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.instruction: 若只用中心場而非線圈內緣的峰值場計算裕度，實際工作點會比設計更靠近臨界面；運轉時一點點熱擾動或冷頭溫度上升數百 mK 就觸發失超，而且失超總在接近滿場時發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Computing margin from the central field instead of the peak field at the winding's inner edge places the true operating point closer to the critical surface than designed; a small disturbance or a few hundred millikelvin of cold-head warming then triggers quenches that consistently occur near full field. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The 4 K heat-load budget: radiation, supports and shielding: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「50 K 輻射屏蔽與 MLI」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “50 K radiation shield and MLI” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 4.2 K 的每一瓦熱都很昂貴：在液氦浴中 1 W 約蒸發 1.4 L/h 液氦，冷凍機系統的二級冷頭通常只有 1 到 2 W。熱進入冷質量有三條路：輻射按 σT⁴ 與表面發射率傳遞，因此在 300 K 與 4 K 之間插入由一級冷頭冷卻的 40 到 60 K 鋁或銅屏蔽，外側再包數十層多層絕熱（MLI）；傳導經過支撐桿、管路與導線，按 Q = (A/L)∫k dT 計算，因此支撐選用 G-10 玻纖環氧或不鏽鋼並在屏蔽溫度做熱錨；第三條是電流引線，留待下一單元。殘氣傳導則靠 10⁻⁴ Pa 以下的絕熱真空壓到可忽略。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「50 K 輻射屏蔽與 MLI」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every watt at 4.2 K is expensive: in a liquid-helium bath 1 W boils about 1.4 L/h, and a cryocooler's second stage usually offers only 1 to 2 W. Heat reaches the cold mass three ways. Radiation follows σT⁴ and surface emissivity, so a 40 to 60 K aluminium or copper shield cooled by the first stage sits between 300 K and 4 K, wrapped in tens of layers of multilayer insulation (MLI). Conduction through supports, tubes and wires follows Q = (A/L)∫k dT, so supports use G-10 glass-epoxy or stainless steel heat-sunk at the shield temperature. Current leads are the third path and get their own unit; residual-gas conduction is made negligible by an insulating vacuum below 10⁻⁴ Pa. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “50 K radiation shield and MLI”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冷質量表面 2 m²：若無屏蔽，300 K 直接輻射到 4.2 K、等效發射率 0.05，Q = 5.67×10⁻⁸×0.05×300⁴×2 ≈ 46 W，相當於 64 L/h 液氦，根本無法運轉。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a 2 m² cold-mass surface.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要真空夠好，就不需要中間溫度的輻射屏蔽。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A good enough vacuum makes an intermediate-temperature radiation shield unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「50 K 輻射屏蔽與 MLI」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “50 K radiation shield and MLI”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 4 K heat-load budget: radiation, supports and shielding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「50 K 輻射屏蔽與 MLI」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “50 K radiation shield and MLI” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冷質量表面 2 m²：若無屏蔽，300 K 直接輻射到 4.2 K、等效發射率 0.05，Q = 5.67×10⁻⁸×0.05×300⁴×2 ≈ 46 W，相當於 64 L/h 液氦，根本無法運轉。加 50 K 屏蔽後，4 K 側只見 σ×0.03×(50⁴ − 4.2⁴)×2 ≈ 21 mW；四支直徑 12 mm、長 0.2 m 的 G-10 支撐，取 4→50 K 熱導積分約 7 W/m（教學假設），Q = (4.52×10⁻⁴/0.2)×7 ≈ 16 mW。屏蔽本身承受 MLI 約 1 W/m²×3 m² ≈ 3 W，由一級冷頭吸收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a 2 m² cold-mass surface. Without a shield, 300 K radiating to 4.2 K with an effective emissivity of 0.05 gives Q = 5.67×10⁻⁸×0.05×300⁴×2 ≈ 46 W, equal to 64 L/h of liquid helium, which is unworkable. With a 50 K shield the 4 K side sees only σ×0.03×(50⁴ − 4.2⁴)×2 ≈ 21 mW; four G-10 supports 12 mm in diameter and 0.2 m long, with a 4→50 K conductivity integral of about 7 W/m (teaching assumption), carry Q = (4.52×10⁻⁴/0.2)×7 ≈ 16 mW. The shield itself takes about 1 W/m² through MLI over 3 m², roughly 3 W, absorbed by the first stage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：穩定後把冷質量當成熱量計：以已知功率的加熱器加 0.1 W 階躍，量溫升或蒸發率的變化求出靈敏度，再反推背景熱負載；屏蔽則以多點溫度計看溫度分佈，若某處比冷頭端高出 10 K 以上，表示 MLI 被壓縮或熱錨不良。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Once stable, use the cold mass as a calorimeter: apply a known 0.1 W heater step and record the change in temperature or boil-off to obtain the sensitivity, then infer the background heat load; map the shield with several thermometers, and treat any point more than 10 K above the cold-head end as evidence of compressed MLI or a poor heat sink.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「50 K 輻射屏蔽與 MLI」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “50 K radiation shield and MLI” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 穩定後把冷質量當成熱量計：以已知功率的加熱器加 0.1 W 階躍，量溫升或蒸發率的變化求出靈敏度，再反推背景熱負載；屏蔽則以多點溫度計看溫度分佈，若某處比冷頭端高出 10 K 以上，表示 MLI 被壓縮或熱錨不良。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Once stable, use the cold mass as a calorimeter: apply a known 0.1 W heater step and record the change in temperature or boil-off to obtain the sensitivity, then infer the background heat load; map the shield with several thermometers, and treat any point more than 10 K above the cold-head end as evidence of compressed MLI or a poor heat sink. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：MLI 在穿越孔、轉角或被支撐壓緊處層間接觸，熱阻崩潰，局部輻射熱漏增加數倍；屏蔽溫度上升後 4 K 端輻射按 T⁴ 增加，常表現為液氦保持時間只有設計的一半，或冷凍機磁體的基礎溫度高出數百 mK。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: MLI layers that touch at penetrations, corners or under supports lose their thermal resistance and multiply the local radiative leak; a warmer shield then raises the 4 K radiation as T⁴, typically showing up as half the designed helium hold time or a cryocooled magnet base temperature several hundred millikelvin high.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。

quiz.question: 要驗證「4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The 4 K heat-load budget: radiation, supports and shielding"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
穩定後把冷質量當成熱量計：以已知功率的加熱器加 0.1 W 階躍，量溫升或蒸發率的變化求出靈敏度，再反推背景熱負載。
零蒸發磁體不需要監測，因為液氦永遠不會減少。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Once stable, use the cold mass as a calorimeter: apply a known 0.1 W heater step and record the change in temperature or boil-off to obtain the sensitivity, then infer the background heat load.
A zero-boil-off magnet needs no monitoring because its helium never depletes.
quiz.explanation: 穩定後把冷質量當成熱量計：以已知功率的加熱器加 0.1 W 階躍，量溫升或蒸發率的變化求出靈敏度，再反推背景熱負載；屏蔽則以多點溫度計看溫度分佈，若某處比冷頭端高出 10 K 以上，表示 MLI 被壓縮或熱錨不良。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Once stable, use the cold mass as a calorimeter: apply a known 0.1 W heater step and record the change in temperature or boil-off to obtain the sensitivity, then infer the background heat load; map the shield with several thermometers, and treat any point more than 10 K above the cold-head end as evidence of compressed MLI or a poor heat sink. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 4 K 熱負載預算：輻射、支撐與屏蔽：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 4 K heat-load budget: radiation, supports and shielding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「50 K 輻射屏蔽與 MLI」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “50 K radiation shield and MLI” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: MLI 在穿越孔、轉角或被支撐壓緊處層間接觸，熱阻崩潰，局部輻射熱漏增加數倍；屏蔽溫度上升後 4 K 端輻射按 T⁴ 增加，常表現為液氦保持時間只有設計的一半，或冷凍機磁體的基礎溫度高出數百 mK。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: MLI layers that touch at penetrations, corners or under supports lose their thermal resistance and multiply the local radiative leak; a warmer shield then raises the 4 K radiation as T⁴, typically showing up as half the designed helium hold time or a cryocooled magnet base temperature several hundred millikelvin high. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘氣傳導則靠 10⁻⁴ Pa 以下的絕熱真空壓到可忽略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Current leads are the third path and get their own unit; residual-gas conduction is made negligible by an insulating vacuum below 10⁻⁴ Pa.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要真空夠好，就不需要中間溫度的輻射屏蔽。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A good enough vacuum makes an intermediate-temperature radiation shield unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導體、繞線、勞侖茲應力與焓裕度」與「電流引線與冷凍機：銅、HTS 與冷頭容量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 導體、繞線、勞侖茲應力與焓裕度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Conductor, winding, Lorentz stress and enthalpy margin: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「環氧含浸線圈與穩定銅」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Epoxy-impregnated winding and stabilizer copper” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 實用 NbTi 線是把數千根 10 到 50 µm 的超導細絲埋在高純銅基體中並扭絞：細絲夠細可抑制磁通跳躍，扭絞可降低耦合損耗，銅則在失超時分流並傳熱。線圈常以真空環氧含浸固定，因為勞侖茲力 J×B 會在通電時推動導線；4 K 下銅的比熱只有約 0.1 J/(kg·K)，導線微米級的滑移或環氧開裂所釋放的能量，就足以把局部加熱超過 T_cs。浸在液氦中的線圈可以靠液氦潛熱吸收擾動，含浸且以傳導冷卻的線圈則沒有這個緩衝，這是訓練現象與兩種冷卻架構的根本差異。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「環氧含浸線圈與穩定銅」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Practical NbTi wire embeds thousands of 10 to 50 µm filaments in a high-purity copper matrix and twists them: fine filaments suppress flux jumps, twisting reduces coupling loss, and the copper shares current and conducts heat during a quench. Windings are often vacuum-impregnated with epoxy because the Lorentz force J×B pushes conductors when energized. At 4 K copper's specific heat is only about 0.1 J/(kg·K), so a micrometre slip or an epoxy crack releases enough energy to heat a spot above T_cs. A coil immersed in liquid helium absorbs disturbances in the helium's latent heat, whereas an impregnated, conduction-cooled coil has no such buffer; this explains training and the basic difference between the two cooling architectures. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Epoxy-impregnated winding and stabilizer copper”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：工程電流密度 J = 200 A/mm²、峰值場 8 T、半徑 R = 50 mm，環向應力 σ ≈ J·B·R = 2×10⁸×8×0.05 = 80 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an engineering current density J = 200 A/mm², peak field 8 T and radius R = 50 mm, the hoop stress is σ ≈ J·B·R = 2×10⁸×8×0.05 = 80 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含浸線圈與浸泡在液氦中的線圈一樣穩定，冷卻方式只影響降溫速度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An impregnated coil is as stable as a bath-immersed one; the cooling method only changes cooldown speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「環氧含浸線圈與穩定銅」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Epoxy-impregnated winding and stabilizer copper”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 導體、繞線、勞侖茲應力與焓裕度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conductor, winding, Lorentz stress and enthalpy margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環氧含浸線圈與穩定銅」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Epoxy-impregnated winding and stabilizer copper” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：工程電流密度 J = 200 A/mm²、峰值場 8 T、半徑 R = 50 mm，環向應力 σ ≈ J·B·R = 2×10⁸×8×0.05 = 80 MPa。勞侖茲力密度 f = J·B = 1.6×10⁹ N/m³，導線滑移 1 µm 釋放 f·δ ≈ 1.6 mJ/cm³；而銅從 4.2 K 加熱到 T_cs = 4.66 K 只需 8.96×10⁻³ kg/cm³×0.1 J/(kg·K)×0.46 K ≈ 0.41 mJ/cm³，擾動是焓裕度的約 4 倍。對照液氦潛熱 0.125 g/cm³×20.7 J/g ≈ 2.6 J/cm³，約為銅焓裕度的 6000 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an engineering current density J = 200 A/mm², peak field 8 T and radius R = 50 mm, the hoop stress is σ ≈ J·B·R = 2×10⁸×8×0.05 = 80 MPa. The Lorentz force density f = J·B = 1.6×10⁹ N/m³, so a 1 µm slip releases f·δ ≈ 1.6 mJ/cm³, whereas heating copper from 4.2 K to T_cs = 4.66 K needs only 8.96×10⁻³ kg/cm³×0.1 J/(kg·K)×0.46 K ≈ 0.41 mJ/cm³, about a quarter of the disturbance. Liquid helium's latent heat, 0.125 g/cm³×20.7 J/g ≈ 2.6 J/cm³, is about 6000 times the copper enthalpy margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繞線後以聲射感測器與電壓分接頭記錄升流過程中的微滑移事件，並記錄每次訓練失超的電流；訓練曲線應在數次內收斂到設計電流的 95% 以上。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After winding, record micro-slip events during ramps with acoustic-emission sensors and voltage taps, and log the current of each training quench; the training curve should converge above 95% of design current within a few quenches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 導體、繞線、勞侖茲應力與焓裕度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conductor, winding, Lorentz stress and enthalpy margin: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「環氧含浸線圈與穩定銅」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Epoxy-impregnated winding and stabilizer copper” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 繞線後以聲射感測器與電壓分接頭記錄升流過程中的微滑移事件，並記錄每次訓練失超的電流；訓練曲線應在數次內收斂到設計電流的 95% 以上。導線的 Cu/SC 比以截面金相量測，RRR 以室溫與剛高於 Tc 的 10 K 電阻比量測，與規格比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After winding, record micro-slip events during ramps with acoustic-emission sensors and voltage taps, and log the current of each training quench; the training curve should converge above 95% of design current within a few quenches. steps.instructionEn: Current leads must deliver around 100 A from room temperature to 4 K while acting as a thermal short. A conduction-cooled magnet has no cold gas, so below the first stage at about 50 K it switches to Bi-2223 or REBCO high-temperature-superconductor leads that generate no Joule heat and ride on a low-conductivity metal sheath. A GM cold head with a reciprocating displacer delivers about 1.5 W at 4.2 K on its second stage, while a pulse-tube head has no moving cold parts and vibrates less, which suits NMR and imaging. steps.objective: 說明「蒸發氣體流量計與低溫溫度計」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boil-off flowmeter and cryogenic thermometers” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液氦系統的熱負載最直接的量法是量蒸發氣體流量：氦在 4.2 K 的汽化潛熱約 20.7 J/g、液體密度 0.125 g/cm³，每公升液體在 0 °C、1 atm 下約變成 700 L 氣體。溫度量測用四線式電阻溫度計：Cernox 與氧化釕感測器在強磁場中的磁阻誤差小，矽二極體在 4 K、數特斯拉下誤差大，只適合放在低場區。所有感測器都需可追溯到 ITS-90 的校正曲線，激發電流要低到自熱可忽略，導線要在屏蔽與冷質量處熱錨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蒸發氣體流量計與低溫溫度計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The most direct heat-load measurement in a bath cryostat is the boil-off gas flow: helium's latent heat at 4.2 K is about 20.7 J/g, the liquid density is 0.125 g/cm³, and each litre of liquid becomes about 700 L of gas at 0 °C and 1 atm. steps.title: 失超偵測、儲能 ½LI² 與氦氣釋放：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「失超偵測電橋與釋壓路徑」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quench-detection bridge and relief path” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 失超時正常區以焦耳熱擴張，線圈儲能 E = ½LI² 必須在熱點溫度過高前被轉移。偵測端把線圈分成兩半接成電橋，抵消升流時兩半相同的感應電壓 L·dI/dt，只留下正常區的電阻電壓；超過門檻並持續一段驗證時間後觸發保護。保護方式包括外部洩能電阻、冷端二極體分段與加熱器強制擴大正常區。對低溫系統而言，釋放到冷質量與液氦中的能量會在數十秒內蒸發大量液氦，因此釋壓閥、破裂片與回收管路的口徑是失超設計的一部分，室內也需缺氧監測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「失超偵測電橋與釋壓路徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a quench the normal zone grows by Joule heating, and the stored energy E = ½LI² must be moved before the hot spot overheats. Detection splits the coil into two halves in a bridge to cancel the identical inductive voltage L·dI/dt during ramps, leaving only the resistive voltage of the normal zone; exceeding a threshold for a validation time triggers protection. Protection uses an external dump resistor, cold diodes across subdivided sections, or heaters that spread the normal zone. For the cryogenic system, energy deposited in the cold mass and bath boils a large volume of helium within tens of seconds, so relief valves, burst discs and recovery-line sizes are part of quench design, and the room needs oxygen-deficiency monitoring. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quench-detection bridge and relief path”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With L = 20 H and I = 100 A, E = ½×20×100² = 100 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「失超只是磁場消失，對低溫系統沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「失超偵測電橋與釋壓路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quench-detection bridge and relief path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：L = 20 H、I = 100 A：E = ½×20×100² = 100 kJ。升流 0.25 A/s 時整體感應電壓 L·dI/dt = 5 V，電橋 0.5% 不平衡剩 25 mV，因此門檻設 100 mV、驗證 10 ms。若 100 kJ 全部進入液氦浴，蒸發 100/2.59 ≈ 39 L 液氦，約 27 m³（0 °C、1 atm）氦氣，釋壓路徑必須在數十秒內排出。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

If all 100 kJ enters the bath it boils 100/2.59 ≈ 39 L of liquid helium, about 27 m³ of gas at 0 °C and 1 atm, which the relief path must vent within tens of seconds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Induce controlled quenches with heaters at reduced current, record detection delay, current-decay time constant, section voltages and cold-mass temperature rise, and compare the total boil-off gas with the energy balance; during ramps log the residual bridge voltage and confirm it stays at least a factor of 3 below the threshold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 持續電流模式、升流損耗與場漂移：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「持續電流開關與超導接頭」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Persistent switch and superconducting joints” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 研究型與 NMR 磁體升到目標電流後，以超導持續電流開關把線圈兩端短路，再把電源降到零，電流在閉合的超導迴路中循環，引線熱負載與電源雜訊同時消失。開關本身是一段非感應繞製的超導線，以加熱器加熱到正常態來打開，加熱期間的數十 mW 直接進入 4 K 級。迴路中的超導接頭有殘餘電阻 R_j，電流以 τ = L/R_j 衰減；升流期間的磁滯與耦合損耗也是 4 K 熱負載，在傳導冷卻系統中會限制升流速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「持續電流開關與超導接頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Research and NMR magnets, once at target current, close a superconducting persistent switch across the coil and ramp the supply to zero, so current circulates in a closed superconducting loop and both lead heat load and supply noise vanish. The switch is a non-inductively wound length of superconductor opened by a heater that drives it normal, and the tens of milliwatts spent while it is open land directly on the 4 K stage. Joints in the loop have a residual resistance R_j, so current decays with τ = L/R_j; hysteresis and coupling losses during ramps also load the 4 K stage and limit the ramp rate of a conduction-cooled system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Persistent switch and superconducting joints”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：L = 20 H、接頭總電阻 R_j = 1 nΩ：τ = 2×10¹⁰ s，場漂移 = 3600/τ ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁷/h = 0.18 ppm/h；NMR 常要求小於 0.01 ppm/h，需 R_j < 20×0.01×10⁻⁶/3600 ≈ 5.6×10⁻¹¹ Ω。升流：電源輸出 5 V 時 dI/dt = V/L = 0.25 A/s，升到 100 A 需 400 s；若升流時磁滯加耦合損耗約 0.2 W（教學假設），加上開關加熱器 30 mW，傳導冷卻二級負載短暫升到約 0.33 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With L = 20 H and a total joint resistance R_j = 1 nΩ, τ = 2×10¹⁰ s and the field drift is 3600/τ ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁷ per hour, or 0.18 ppm/h; NMR typically needs less than 0.01 ppm/h, requiring R_j < 20×0.01×10⁻⁶/3600 ≈ 5.6×10⁻¹¹ Ω. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Persistent switch and superconducting joints” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 進入持續模式後以 NMR 探頭或高穩定霍爾探頭連續記錄場值 24 到 72 小時，扣除探頭溫度漂移後擬合衰減率，反推 R_j；升流時同步記錄二級溫度，確認在最大升流速度下冷質量仍低於 T_cs 至少 1 K。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After entering persistent mode, log the field with an NMR probe or a high-stability Hall probe for 24 to 72 hours, remove probe temperature drift and fit the decay rate to infer R_j; during ramps log the second-stage temperature and confirm that at the maximum ramp rate the cold mass stays at least 1 K below T_cs. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：開關加熱器關閉後若冷卻時間不足就讓電源降流，開關仍在正常態，電流流入發熱中的開關，使其燒毀或觸發失超；接頭製作不良的磁體則表現為每小時數 ppm 的漂移，NMR 鎖場迴路需持續大量補償。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Ramping the supply down before the switch has cooled after its heater is turned off leaves the switch normal, so current flows into a hot switch that can burn out or trigger a quench; a magnet with poor joints drifts several ppm per hour, forcing the NMR lock loop to compensate continuously.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 持續電流模式、升流損耗與場漂移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Persistent mode, ramp losses and field drift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「持續電流開關與超導接頭」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Persistent switch and superconducting joints” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 開關加熱器關閉後若冷卻時間不足就讓電源降流，開關仍在正常態，電流流入發熱中的開關，使其燒毀或觸發失超；接頭製作不良的磁體則表現為每小時數 ppm 的漂移，NMR 鎖場迴路需持續大量補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Joints in the loop have a residual resistance R_j, so current decays with τ = L/R_j; hysteresis and coupling losses during ramps also load the 4 K stage and limit the ramp rate of a conduction-cooled system.

steps.title: 降溫、零蒸發運轉與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cooldown, zero-boil-off operation and acceptance handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「降溫紀錄與再冷凝冷頭」如何決定超導磁體低溫系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cooldown record and recondensing cold head” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液氦磁體降溫通常先用液氮把冷質量預冷到 77 K，因為銅從 300 K 到 77 K 要移除約 73 kJ/kg，而 77 K 以下只剩約 5 kJ/kg；預冷後必須把液氮完全排淨再灌液氦，否則殘留的固態氮會消耗液氦並阻塞管路。現代系統再以 4 K 冷頭在頸管中把蒸發的氦氣再冷凝，達成零蒸發運轉，並以加熱器維持容器略高於大氣壓，防止空氣倒灌結冰。驗收要同時交付溫度裕度、熱負載、失超紀錄、場漂移與冷頭保養週期。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「降溫紀錄與再冷凝冷頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bath magnet is usually precooled to 77 K with liquid nitrogen, because copper sheds about 73 kJ/kg between 300 and 77 K but only about 5 kJ/kg below 77 K; the nitrogen must then be removed completely before helium transfer, or residual solid nitrogen consumes helium and blocks lines. Modern systems add a 4 K cold head in the neck to recondense boil-off for zero-boil-off operation, with a heater holding the vessel slightly above atmospheric pressure so air cannot back-stream and freeze. Acceptance must hand over temperature margin, heat load, quench history, field drift and the cold-head maintenance interval together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cooldown record and recondensing cold head”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：150 kg 冷質量（以銅估算）：液氮預冷只計潛熱需 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L 液氮（液氮潛熱約 160 kJ/L）；77→4.2 K 若只用液氦潛熱需 150×5/2.59 ≈ 290 L，若讓冷氦氣的顯熱（4.2→77 K 約 380 J/g）一起吸熱，理想值降到 750 kJ/(0.125 kg/L×400 kJ/kg) ≈ 15 L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 150 kg cold mass treated as copper, nitrogen precooling with latent heat only takes 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L of liquid nitrogen (latent heat about 160 kJ/L); cooling from 77 to 4.2 K with helium latent heat alone needs 150×5/2.59 ≈ 290 L, but letting the cold gas's sensible heat (about 380 J/g from 4.2 to 77 K) absorb heat as well lowers the ideal to 750 kJ/(0.125 kg/L×400 kJ/kg) ≈ 15 L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「零蒸發磁體不需要監測，因為液氦永遠不會減少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A zero-boil-off magnet needs no monitoring because its helium never depletes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「降溫紀錄與再冷凝冷頭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cooldown record and recondensing cold head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 降溫、零蒸發運轉與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cooldown, zero-boil-off operation and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「降溫紀錄與再冷凝冷頭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cooldown record and recondensing cold head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：150 kg 冷質量（以銅估算）：液氮預冷只計潛熱需 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L 液氮（液氮潛熱約 160 kJ/L）；77→4.2 K 若只用液氦潛熱需 150×5/2.59 ≈ 290 L，若讓冷氦氣的顯熱（4.2→77 K 約 380 J/g）一起吸熱，理想值降到 750 kJ/(0.125 kg/L×400 kJ/kg) ≈ 15 L。零蒸發：再冷凝冷頭 1.5 W @ 4.2 K，量得靜態負載 0.25 W，餘量約 1.25 W 由控壓加熱器吸收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 150 kg cold mass treated as copper, nitrogen precooling with latent heat only takes 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L of liquid nitrogen (latent heat about 160 kJ/L); cooling from 77 to 4.2 K with helium latent heat alone needs 150×5/2.59 ≈ 290 L, but letting the cold gas's sensible heat (about 380 J/g from 4.2 to 77 K) absorb heat as well lowers the ideal to 750 kJ/(0.125 kg/L×400 kJ/kg) ≈ 15 L. For zero boil-off, a 1.5 W at 4.2 K recondensing head against a measured 0.25 W static load leaves about 1.25 W of margin, absorbed by the pressure-control heater. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時以控壓加熱器功率直接讀出冷頭餘量：加熱器功率下降代表熱負載上升或冷頭衰退；滿場持續 24 小時液面不降、壓力穩定在設定值，記錄冷頭運轉時數並對照 10,000 小時保養週期，把降溫曲線、訓練紀錄、漂移與熱負載量測整理成交接文件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At acceptance, read the cold-head margin directly from the pressure-control heater power, since a falling heater power means a rising heat load or a degrading cold head; hold full field for 24 hours with no level loss and pressure steady at set point, log cold-head hours against the 10,000 h maintenance interval, and compile the cooldown curve, training record, drift and heat-load data into the handoff file.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

optionsEn: For a 150 kg cold mass treated as copper, nitrogen precooling with latent heat only takes 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L of liquid nitrogen (latent heat about 160 kJ/L).
An impregnated coil is as stable as a bath-immersed one; the cooling method only changes cooldown speed.
A silicon diode reads 4 K accurately in any magnetic field.
quiz.explanation: 150 kg 冷質量（以銅估算）：液氮預冷只計潛熱需 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L 液氮（液氮潛熱約 160 kJ/L）；77→4.2 K 若只用液氦潛熱需 150×5/2.59 ≈ 290 L，若讓冷氦氣的顯熱（4.2→77 K 約 380 J/g）一起吸熱，理想值降到 750 kJ/(0.125 kg/L×400 kJ/kg) ≈ 15 L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 150 kg cold mass treated as copper, nitrogen precooling with latent heat only takes 150×73/160 ≈ 68 L of liquid nitrogen (latent heat about 160 kJ/L); cooling from 77 to 4.2 K with helium latent heat alone needs 150×5/2.59 ≈ 290 L, but letting the cold gas's sensible heat (about 380 J/g from 4.2 to 77 K) absorb heat as well lowers the ideal to 750 kJ/(0.125 kg/L×400 kJ/kg) ≈ 15 L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 降溫、零蒸發運轉與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cooldown, zero-boil-off operation and acceptance handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「降溫紀錄與再冷凝冷頭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cooldown record and recondensing cold head” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收時以控壓加熱器功率直接讀出冷頭餘量：加熱器功率下降代表熱負載上升或冷頭衰退；滿場持續 24 小時液面不降、壓力穩定在設定值，記錄冷頭運轉時數並對照 10,000 小時保養週期，把降溫曲線、訓練紀錄、漂移與熱負載量測整理成交接文件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At acceptance, read the cold-head margin directly from the pressure-control heater power, since a falling heater power means a rising heat load or a degrading cold head; hold full field for 24 hours with no level loss and pressure steady at set point, log cold-head hours against the 10,000 h maintenance interval, and compile the cooldown curve, training record, drift and heat-load data into the handoff file. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷頭保養逾期後容量逐月下降，控壓加熱器功率逐漸歸零卻無人注意，直到容器壓力上升、液氦開始消耗；若容器曾短暫負壓，倒灌的空氣在頸管結冰，可能阻塞釋壓路徑，留下下一次失超時的過壓風險。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Past its maintenance interval a cold head loses capacity month by month and the pressure-control heater power quietly falls to zero until vessel pressure rises and helium starts to deplete; if the vessel ever runs below atmospheric pressure, back-streamed air freezes in the neck and can block the relief path, leaving an over-pressure risk for the next quench.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收時以控壓加熱器功率直接讀出冷頭餘量：加熱器功率下降代表熱負載上升或冷頭衰退；滿場持續 24 小時液面不降、壓力穩定在設定值，記錄冷頭運轉時數並對照 10,000 小時保養週期，把降溫曲線、訓練紀錄、漂移與熱負載量測整理成交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: At acceptance, read the cold-head margin directly from the pressure-control heater power, since a falling heater power means a rising heat load or a degrading cold head; hold full field for 24 hours with no level loss and pressure steady at set point, log cold-head hours against the 10,000 h maintenance interval, and compile the cooldown curve, training record, drift and heat-load data into the handoff file.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「降溫、零蒸發運轉與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cooldown, zero-boil-off operation and acceptance handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收時以控壓加熱器功率直接讀出冷頭餘量：加熱器功率下降代表熱負載上升或冷頭衰退。
失超只是磁場消失，對低溫系統沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
At acceptance, read the cold-head margin directly from the pressure-control heater power, since a falling heater power means a rising heat load or a degrading cold head.
A quench just removes the field and has no effect on the cryogenic system.
quiz.explanation: 驗收時以控壓加熱器功率直接讀出冷頭餘量：加熱器功率下降代表熱負載上升或冷頭衰退；滿場持續 24 小時液面不降、壓力穩定在設定值，記錄冷頭運轉時數並對照 10,000 小時保養週期，把降溫曲線、訓練紀錄、漂移與熱負載量測整理成交接文件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At acceptance, read the cold-head margin directly from the pressure-control heater power, since a falling heater power means a rising heat load or a degrading cold head; hold full field for 24 hours with no level loss and pressure steady at set point, log cold-head hours against the 10,000 h maintenance interval, and compile the cooldown curve, training record, drift and heat-load data into the handoff file. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 降溫、零蒸發運轉與驗收交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cooldown, zero-boil-off operation and acceptance handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「降溫紀錄與再冷凝冷頭」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cooldown record and recondensing cold head” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷頭保養逾期後容量逐月下降，控壓加熱器功率逐漸歸零卻無人注意，直到容器壓力上升、液氦開始消耗；若容器曾短暫負壓，倒灌的空氣在頸管結冰，可能阻塞釋壓路徑，留下下一次失超時的過壓風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Past its maintenance interval a cold head loses capacity month by month and the pressure-control heater power quietly falls to zero until vessel pressure rises and helium starts to deplete; if the vessel ever runs below atmospheric pressure, back-streamed air freezes in the neck and can block the relief path, leaving an over-pressure risk for the next quench. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收要同時交付溫度裕度、熱負載、失超紀錄、場漂移與冷頭保養週期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance must hand over temperature margin, heat load, quench history, field drift and the cold-head maintenance interval together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「零蒸發磁體不需要監測，因為液氦永遠不會減少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A zero-boil-off magnet needs no monitoring because its helium never depletes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 冷頭保養逾期後容量逐月下降，控壓加熱器功率逐漸歸零卻無人注意，直到容器壓力上升、液氦開始消耗；若容器曾短暫負壓，倒灌的空氣在頸管結冰，可能阻塞釋壓路徑，留下下一次失超時的過壓風險。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「降溫、零蒸發運轉與驗收交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cooldown, zero-boil-off operation and acceptance handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
